content: Variation on the behavior level In addition to variation of the VFB-related model elements, the description of variant software-component implemen- tations is supported. Please note that this requires a broad support of variability in the Internal Behavior . The identified main use case are • the existence of RunnableEntity s • the existence of RTEEvent s • the existence of VariableDataPrototype s in the roles implicitInter- RunnableVariable and explicitInterRunnableVariable • the existence of ParameterDataPrototype s in the roles perInstancePa- rameter , sharedParameter , and constantMemory
